summary: Private (VPC): streaming completion truncates after customer network policy update
description: Customer reports that after updating egress/NACL rules, streaming responses sometimes end early. Non-streaming calls are fine. They see FIN from their side at ~60s consistently.
comments: SE (Diego): Noted default idle timeouts on their NLB may be 60s; asked for LB type + settings.
Customer: Confirmed AWS NLB idle timeout 60s and their app does long generations w/ low token/sec.
SE (Diego): Recommended increasing NLB idle timeout and/or enabling periodic SSE keep-alive 'data:' comment frames from the gateway.
Support: Customer increased timeout to 300s; truncations stopped. Marking resolved.
